\chapter{How to use this guide}
\textbf{Exam pattern} (PYQM\_2025\_Midsem\_1\_Computer\_Networks\_1 p1): Answer any four questions including Q1 (compulsory). Q1: 5 x 1 mark; answer any 3 of Q2-Q5, 5 marks each. 2025: Q2-Q4 split 3 + 2 marks, Q5 = short notes on any two of three (2.5 x 2). 2022/2024: each 2.5 + 2.5. Full marks 20, 1.5 h.
\paragraph{Order of this guide.} Exam Radar (what is likely) $\rightarrow$ unit notes $\rightarrow$ important questions ranked by expected marks $\rightarrow$ past papers solved verbatim $\rightarrow$ mock paper $\rightarrow$ cheatsheet (also a separate PDF for the last hour).
\paragraph{Suggested method.} (1) Skim the Exam Radar and pick the study plan that fits your time. (2) For each idea in that plan: read the notes section, then solve the matching PYQ on paper \emph{before} reading the solution. (3) Attempt the mock paper under exam time. (4) Revise from the cheatsheet.
\paragraph{Badges.} \tier{A} $P\ge60\%$ \quad \tier{B} 35--59\% \quad \tier{C} 15--34\% \quad \tier{D} never asked but heavily taught \quad (below 15\% and never asked: long shot, not listed) \quad \prob{70} chance of appearing \quad \ev{1.5} expected marks \quad \mks{2.5} marks \quad \src{N\_slides p12} source in the instructor's notes.
\paragraph{Storyboards.} Step-by-step figures print as numbered frames; in Adobe Acrobat, Okular or Foxit the same figure also plays as an animation (use the controls under it).
